lines.intro: A fizzy bluebird flaps in circles, kicking up a sandy gust!
lines.command: How can Fae calm the flappy bird?

soothe.great: Fae speaks softly. The bluebird's wings slow to a gentle flutter!
soothe.good: Fae speaks softly, and the bluebird listens for a moment.
soothe.miss: The bluebird flaps too fast to hear Fae.

play.great: Maddie chases a feather. The bluebird chirps and follows!
play.good: Maddie bats a feather nearby. The bluebird watches.
play.miss: Maddie pounces on a shell. The bluebird flutters higher.

cast.great: Sue casts her ribbon bobber. The bluebird follows its bright wiggle!
cast.good: Sue's bobber bobs past. The bluebird pauses to watch.
cast.miss: Sue's ribbon bobber flops in the sand. The bluebird keeps flapping.

juggle.great: Jordan juggles three pinecones. The bluebird hops along to the rhythm!
juggle.good: Jordan tosses a pinecone up high. The bluebird chirps, curious.
juggle.miss: Jordan drops all three pinecones in the sand. The bluebird ruffles its feathers.

lines.snack: Fae shares a crunchy cracker. The bluebird chirps happily.
lines.burst: The bluebird kicks up a fizzy gust of sand!

burstResult.great: Fae ducks neatly under the sandy swirl!
burstResult.good: Fae brushes a little sand from her sleeve.
burstResult.miss: Poof! Sand lands all around Fae.

lines.soothed: The bluebird settles on a shell, calm and bright.
lines.rest: Fae is tuckered out. Time for a little rest.
lines.run: Fae backs away slowly. The bluebird keeps fluttering.
